label: Dashboard
explanation: Canonical monthly analytics with explicit source-module requirements. Action recommendations and administrative filter options are excluded; analysis remains with the agent. No recent-activity feed is inferred.

label: Production Planning
explanation: Planning records and canonical current open-order quantities with invalid/missing-data diagnostics. Open quantities require Job Order and Finished Goods access. Stock-readiness recommendations and par-level calculations remain in the Planning UI.

label: Production Overview
explanation: Monthly performance plus the canonical daily pipeline, saved lifecycle states and output totals. Pipeline requires Job Order and Production Records access; monthly performance requires its contributing modules. Requests never release or change Job Orders.

label: Job Order
explanation: Saved order planning and lifecycle fields. Detailed product, procedure and execution data require their own modules.

label: Production Records
explanation: Saved runs, execution steps, QC checklist results and remarks-presence flags, legacy QC checkpoints and material quantities. Personnel, remarks text and detailed linked documents are excluded.

label: Production Reports
explanation: Saved production, material usage, product movements and receiving cost basis. Each dataset requires its owning module. UI-calculated costing, yield ratios and cost trends are not returned as authoritative report totals; missing costs and historical usage remain unresolved.

label: Batch Traceability
explanation: Canonical batch reconciliation and saved raw allocations. Summaries require all contributing modules; linked records are not expanded automatically.

label: Product Feedback
explanation: Campaigns, tasting variants and anonymous daily response counts only. Answers, contacts and detailed insight analytics are excluded.

label: Petty Cash
explanation: Transaction amounts, types, dates, states and categories only. Receipt files, parties and free text are excluded.

label: Finished Goods
explanation: Saved SKU, packaging, price, category and batch balance records. Production history, movement documents and Location details require their owning modules; no reconstructed historical stock valuation.

label: Finished Goods Dispatch
explanation: Saved dispatch documents, items and batch allocations. Related customer, product and production links require their own modules.

label: Product Movements
explanation: Saved product movement quantities, types and dates. Related records require their own modules.

label: Product Stock Check
explanation: Stock-check documents, counts, positive-adjustment confirmation and saved batch adjustment allocations. Batch and Location details require their own modules. Personal actors and free-text variance explanations are excluded.

label: Internal Transfer
explanation: Saved transfers and item quantities. Batch, material and location links require their own modules.

label: Raw Material Receiving
explanation: Receiving documents, items, quantities, lifecycle states and saved unit/total cost basis. Related records and MeSTI acceptance/control evidence require their own modules. Invoice files, personal contacts and free text are excluded.

label: Raw Material Inventory
explanation: Material and batch records, categories, declared UOM conversion and saved manual cost basis. Related receiving and Location records require separate access. No reconstructed historical valuation or invented conversions.

label: Raw Material Movements
explanation: Saved raw material movement quantities, types and dates. Related records require their own modules.

label: Raw Material Stock Check
explanation: Stock-check documents, counts and saved batch adjustment allocations. Batch details require Raw Material Inventory access. Personal actors and free-text reasons are excluded.

label: Cleaning of Area
explanation: Area-cleaning requirements, schedules, saved states and redacted proof only. Grant Locations separately to identify linked areas.

label: Cleaning of Equipment
explanation: Equipment-cleaning requirements, schedules, saved states and redacted proof only. Equipment and Production links require their own modules.

label: Calibration Schedule & Record
explanation: Calibration requirements, due dates, saved results and verification states only. Equipment details require Equipment access.

label: Finished Product Storage Control
explanation: Canonical completed-production storage quantities, packaging UOM, completion date/time, batch provenance and expiry. Production, product and Location identities require their own modules. No temperature telemetry or reconstructed historical storage conditions.

label: Health Declaration
explanation: Daily non-voided declaration counts only. Individual health records and required-personnel coverage are unavailable to agents.

label: Operator Hygiene Inspection
explanation: Saved sessions and aggregate proof only. Individual results and required-personnel coverage are unavailable to agents.

label: Waste Disposal Record
explanation: Waste requirements, schedules, sessions and events only. Grant Locations separately to identify linked areas.

label: Raw Material Control
explanation: Raw material acceptance/control standards and their saved receiving evidence. No inventory quantities or commercial details.

label: Food Processing Control
explanation: Canonical completed-production lifecycle, output quantities, QC requirement/evidence counts, No QC Required versus Evidence unavailable, and redacted saved QC proof. Staff and free-text results are excluded; historical SOP edits are not reconstructed.

label: Product Recipes
explanation: Recipe versions, ingredient quantities, product families and family tags. Material details and costs require Raw Material Inventory access. Personal actors, free-text remarks and historical edits are excluded.

label: Production SOP
explanation: Procedure versions, main steps, substeps, QC definitions and equipment bindings. Equipment and Recipe details require their own modules. Free-text remarks and unpublished historical edits are excluded.

label: Equipment
explanation: Equipment masters, categories and saved state. Locations and SOP bindings require their owning modules. No equipment-usage ledger or historical assignment reconstruction is invented.

label: Audit Trail
explanation: Event classifications, outcomes and times only, for other granted business modules. Actors, before/after details and unclassified events are omitted.

label: Locations
explanation: Location master records only. Inventory contents and operational documents require their own modules.

label: Suppliers
explanation: Supplier identifiers, names, state and saved material-eligibility links. Material details require Raw Material Inventory access. Personal contacts, free text and historical eligibility reconstruction are excluded.

label: Customers
explanation: Customer identifiers, names, type and state only. Contacts, addresses and linked dispatch details are not included.
